addTranslationDescription: Help make this story available in more languages. A copy of the story is created that you can translate in the StoryLab.
chooseLanguage: Which language do you want to translate into?
flowStep1: Translate the story's texts in the StoryLab
flowStep2: Submit the translation to the author
flowStep3: Once approved, the translation appears in the viewer
createError: The translation could not be created.
languageExists: There already is a translation for this language.
mediaOnlyInOriginal: Media and embeds can only be changed in the original story.
markerOnlyInOriginal: Markers can only be set in the original story.
settingsFromOriginal: Mode, theme and lines are taken from the original story.
settingsOwnerOnly: As a translator you can change name, author and description. Other settings are managed by the author.
submitDescription: The translation will be sent to the author of “{{- story}}”. It appears in the viewer once it has been approved. Until then you can keep working on it.
submitError: The translation could not be submitted.
bannerTitle: Translation of “{{- story}}” {{flag}} – only texts can be edited.
bannerDetails: In translations only texts can be translated. Markers, steps, media and order are managed in the original story and taken over automatically. New content from the original is marked with “Needs translation”.
reviewDescription: Other users have submitted translations of your story. Approved translations appear in the viewer, and both of you can keep editing them.
noRequests: There are currently no submitted translations.
reviewError: The action could not be performed.
rejectDescription: The translator can then revise the translation and submit it again.
